dataset.name: UK HGV road user levy (non-UK vehicles)
dataset.method: HGV Road User Levy Act 2013, section 6 and Schedule 1 (Tables 1, 1A and 1B) as amended: a non-UK HGV of 12,000 kg or more pays the daily rate for each day it uses a main road, by band of maximum permitted (revenue) weight of the combination and by whether it meets Euro 6. Rates as tabulated by the Department for Transport's guidance. Zero-emission HGVs are exempt. The table keeps the daily rate.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: GOV.UK: How to use the HGV levy service (rates; a day runs from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59)
The guidance as archived by the Internet Archive (20250615)

vehicles.description: Non-UK heavy goods vehicles of 12,000 kg or more (UK vehicles pay yearly or half-yearly with vehicle excise duty)

network.description: Main roads: roads numbered with A or M, in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
